title: With a back on her like a ballalley
html_source: This excellent note from my Penguin 20th c. Classics Annotated Students' Edition: “The Fenian hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill could permit ‘five times fifty fosterlings’ to play handball against his backside; but such dimensions are less flattering to Molly”

anchor.prefix: an and she's far from the land. And Bloom, of course, with his knockmedown cigar putting on swank with his lardy face. Phenomenon! The fat heap he married is a nice old phenomenon
